You can get the rulings/errata/etc. in (reverse) chronological order
through the Rulemonger search page. Just pick one of the Rulemonger
mirrors listed at http://www.geocities.com/TimesSquare/Realm/9876/
and select "Power Search".
Leave the "Search String" blank to select all records, and then just
stop reading when you reach a ruling prior to January.
